completion_evidence: Source-derived atoms and provider or framework variants are cited; required checks and authorization evidence are recorded.
hard_gates: Fail closed on missing authority, credentials, source evidence, required data governance, or verification.
inputs: Secret classes, environments, providers, CI/runtime paths, owners, rotation requirements, and authorization.
name: Secrets And Environment Governance
non_responsibility: Does not absorb unrelated lifecycle responsibilities or expand provider, workspace, or remote-write authority implicitly.
outputs: Secrets and environment contract, least-exposure controls, verification plan, and rotation or revocation procedure.

provider_or_framework_variants.applies_when: Select only when provider=github-actions and environment=ci; otherwise route to another evidenced adapter or return needs-input.

responsibility: Define and verify secret, credential, environment, output, retention, and rotation boundaries without exposing values.
stop_conditions: Stop before destructive, external-write, merge, deploy, or production action without current explicit authorization.
